repository_principles.principle: Keep durable state rules in their bounded-context owner and test semantics rather than incidental output.

lens_reviews.summary: The extracted registry projection reuses the existing capability and checkpoint normalization helpers.
The public goal_boundary signature and optional return contract remain unchanged.
Registry coordination remains the single source for scope, capabilities, approvals, and guards.
Registry-owned projection is separated from downstream runtime and integration augmentation.
One owner-local helper removes branch density without introducing a generic projection framework.
The extraction preserves the existing bounded list normalization and adds no repeated I/O.
Malformed optional registry fields continue to normalize to empty projections instead of broad fallback.
Precedence, deduplication, checkpoint activity, and policy fields have direct semantic assertions.
No public documentation contract changes in this internal behavior-preserving extraction.
Item-local values cannot override registry authority for write scope or capability grants.

simplification_decisions.subject: registry-owned goal boundary fields
simplification_decisions.reason: The helper is a cohesive bounded-context extraction with a shipped caller and direct parity tests.

repository_principles.principle: Move benchmark projection rules into the benchmark read-model owner while preserving public-safe boundaries and parity.

lens_reviews.summary: The read model reuses public-safe text, list, numeric, and environment-failure compactors.
The status compact_benchmark_run facade remains the caller-facing API while helpers become directly testable.
Validation field classes and trial bounds are single-sourced in the benchmark projection module.
Benchmark validation and trial compaction now live with the benchmark read model rather than the global status facade.
The move reduces status branch density while keeping the validation and trial rule groups cohesive.
Trial projection remains bounded by max_trials and max_list_items and stops once the bound is reached.
Neutral false flags and missing worker trace or setup failures remain explicit rather than silently disappearing.
Direct helper tests and facade integration assertions cover neutral, negative, bounded, and public-safe behavior.
Named field groups document the projection contract next to the owning implementation.
Public-safe compaction and explicit trial bounds preserve the benchmark evidence boundary.

simplification_decisions.subject: benchmark validation and trial compaction
simplification_decisions.reason: The move collapses one durable rule owner without changing the public facade or creating a universal compactor.

validation_evidence.scope: benchmark projection helpers, status facade parity, and neighboring benchmark behavior

repository_principles.principle: Make control-plane state transitions explicit, preserve recovery semantics, and validate ordered effects with focused tests.

lens_reviews.summary: The stage helpers retain existing journal, receipt, validation, callback, and execution-payload helpers.
run_loopx_turn_once keeps its external signature while internal stages return explicit typed tuples or payloads.
This extraction changes no configuration source or execution mode selection.
Host result, task validation, and transaction closeout each own one ordered recoverable stage.
Three cohesive stages replace one oversized orchestrator and the bounded repair preserves mutable callback results.
Recovery still skips completed phases and does not repeat host, writeback, or spend effects.
Each stage records its failed phase, reason, receipt, and durable journal before returning.
Interrupted writeback and spend recovery assert exact completed-phase prefixes and effect replay behavior.
Stage helper names expose transaction boundaries without adding parallel prose truth.
Writeback still precedes quota spend and scheduler apply or acknowledgement on every resumed path.

simplification_decisions.subject: transaction closeout callback payload handling
simplification_decisions.reason: The single safe-fix pass kept callback mutation semantics while retaining the three-stage extraction.

validation_evidence.scope: Turn executor and driver recovery semantics plus maintainability ratchet

repository_principles.principle: Represent goal-frontier invariants once and test legal and illegal transitions instead of preserving contradictory guidance.

lens_reviews.summary: The same repeat-Vision predicate and satisfying delta-kind tuple drive ACK validation and guidance alignment.
The obligation projection adds explicit satisfying delta kinds without changing the existing ACK schema.
The change is selected from persisted Vision advancement policy rather than a new configuration flag.
Goal-frontier projection owns both replan acceptance and the guidance exposed to agents.
A shared predicate removes duplicated trigger interpretation while preserving as-needed Vision behavior.
The alignment operates on the already-built bounded obligation and acceptance-gap lists.
Watch-only continuation is rejected explicitly instead of creating another silent no-progress cycle.
Tests cover repeat-until-closed rejection and the as-needed wait-continuation counterexample.
The helper docstring names the advancement policy boundary and keeps projected guidance current.
The repair changes no authority or write permission and only narrows what counts as a valid replan ACK.

simplification_decisions.subject: repeat-Vision replan guidance and ACK acceptance
simplification_decisions.reason: One shared predicate and one ordered delta-kind contract remove the contradictory watch-only route.

repository_principles.principle: Capability-gated projections stay default-off, propagate through real callers, and partition caches by semantic request identity.

lens_reviews.summary: Cache identity reuses canonical capability normalization from the todo contract.
Status-backed callers expose one repeatable available-capability envelope and preserve omitted defaults.
Material projection remains selected by the observed execution envelope rather than persisted user configuration.
Status collection transports the envelope and the agent-management projection remains the field owner.
Explicit caller forwarding is retained because it preserves ownership without introducing a hidden ambient capability context.
Normalized capability sets participate in cache identity so gated and default projections cannot cross-hit.
Absent capability declarations fail closed by omitting material fields rather than falling back to private material reads.
Real status collection, cache identity, and status or quota or review parity paths are covered.
The protocol reference now states default-off projection and explicit capability observation.
The capability only reveals a prebuilt public-safe frontier and never grants access to material bodies.

simplification_decisions.subject: capability propagation through status-backed callers
simplification_decisions.reason: Explicit forwarding is repetitive but keeps request identity and capability ownership visible at each public caller.

validation_evidence.scope: material capability projection, cache partitioning, CLI parity, and output budgets
